court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Shishir S/O Sharad Kinkar vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Ps Gadge Nagar

parties.respondent_defendant: State of Maharashtra, through the Police Station Officer, Gadge Nagar Police Station, Amravati and another

facts_of_case: The applicant seeks quashing of the First Information Report lodged by his wife- non-applicant No.2 under Section 498-A of the Indian Penal Code. Both parties arrived at an amicable settlement and filed consent terms before the Family Court, which dissolved the marriage.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish that the First Information Report is malicious and deserves quashing.
legal_principles.held: In view of settlement of the matrimonial dispute between the parties, the applicant has failed to demonstrate any malice or harassment by non-applicant No.2.

legal_principles.principle: Consent terms and settlements between parties can lead to dissolution of marriage under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: As per the consent terms, the applicant- Shishir deposited an amount of Rs.50,00,000/- with the Family Court, Nagpur and the non-applicant No.2 has agreed not to prosecute the criminal proceedings further.

outcome.final_order: The First Information Report registered vide Crime No.2472/2021 with the Police Station Gadge Nagar, Amravati for the offence punishable under Section 498-A of the Indian Penal Code is hereby quashed and set aside.

use_for_drafting: quashing FIRs in domestic violence cases
